{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Midwestern cuisine|Midwestern cuisine]]

'''Green bean casserole''' was invented in 1955 by the Campbell Soup Company. It has since become a popular Thanksgiving side dish in the United States.

== Ingredients ==
* 8 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cooked [[Cookbook:Green Bean|green beans]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 2 ⅔ cups canned French fried [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], divided into 2 equal portions
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|ground black pepper]]
* 2 cans (21 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) cream of [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]] [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]]
* 2 teaspoons [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|350°F]] (175°C).
# Stir together beans, milk, ½ of onions, pepper, soup, and soy sauce in a 3-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] until hot, about 25 minutes.
# Sprinkle top with rest of onions.
# Bake another 5 minutes.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Cream of mushroom soup may be regular or reduced sodium.
* Other cream soups such as cream of onion or potato may be used.
* If you love [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]], substitute ½ cup shredded cheese for the soy sauce.
* ½ cup of chopped [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|red bell peppers]] will make it very colorful.
